notes: The `aeco:props:<set>:<prop>` quarantine (rule E7) is deliberately open — any tool may stash namespaced data there without schema change. This registry makes the SET names enumerable so conformance can REPORT (warn, never error) which sets a stage uses and flag ones outside the sanctioned families, turning an open convention into a measurable one. A `*` suffix marks an open family (any suffix allowed). Projects add their own set names through a project profile.
